title: Waymo cars stranded on San Francisco streets as Fourth of July gridlock drains batteries

reading.body:
Waymo's autonomous vehicles were designed and tested to operate in normal traffic conditions, not in the severe, sustained gridlock that occurred during Fourth of July celebrations in San Francisco. When unexpected road closures and major events created hours-long traffic jams, the vehicles' batteries drained faster than their operating range could sustain, leaving at least a dozen cars immobilized on city streets.

This reveals a deployment outside tested conditions rather than a failure in the vehicles' core autonomous driving systems. The cars performed their basic function of navigating traffic, but the infrastructure and energy planning assumed normal traffic patterns. Catching this would have required modeling battery consumption across extended gridlock scenarios or restricting service during foreseeable high-congestion events.

It is not established whether Waymo had visibility into the Fourth of July event planning, whether similar traffic scenarios had been anticipated, or what specific improvements the company's evaluation produced.

reports.title: Waymo cars stranded on San Francisco streets as Fourth of July gridlock drains batteries

summary:
Multiple Waymo autonomous vehicles became stranded on San Francisco streets during Fourth of July celebrations when their batteries drained in heavy traffic following fireworks displays near the Golden Gate Bridge. Video footage showed at least a dozen stationary Waymo cars, primarily Jaguar I-PACE models, lined up on streets with some requiring towing. The company attributed the problem to major traffic disruptions, high traveler volume, and unplanned road closures that caused unexpected congestion in the area.

Waymo stated its roadside assistance team worked to clear the vehicles and is evaluating ways to improve resilience during major traffic events. Witnesses reported frustration as stranded autonomous vehicles blocked roadways for hours, with some drivers spending nearly two hours in standstill traffic. Additionally, one Waymo vehicle caught fire after driving over fireworks, though no injuries occurred. San Francisco's mayor acknowledged the situation and said his office would discuss the incident with public and private partners to improve future event management.
